'''Maric Mandragoran''' is the son of [[Lan Mandragoran]] and [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] in Nynaeve's [[Accepted]] test.{{ref/book|2|23}}

==Activities==
He has a sister named [[Elnore Mandragoran|Elnore]].

Lan tells Nynaeve that Maric cannot decide whether he likes horses or books better.{{ref/book|2|23}}
